_note: The spreads for the Words deck, written by hand. scripts/build_words_deck.py reads this file with glossary/terms.json and writes site/viewers/spreads.json (what the Spread Caster reads); scripts/build-glossary.mjs lists the same spreads on the glossary page. A position with a term_id takes that term's name as its label and the term's definition as its meaning, unless it sets its own. x and y place the position on the board, as fractions of its width and height (0 to 1). Ids are linked from the site header (before-you-delegate, the-fork, single), so keep them once published. Author PlayfulProcess; CC-BY-SA-4.0.
